text:
Two small cucumber maki pieces sit on a plate about 26 cm across. Each piece is roughly 2.5–3 cm in diameter and about 2.5 cm tall, so each weighs about 14–16 g. Together that is about 30 g. Of this, roughly 22 g is rice, 4 g is cucumber and 2 g is nori, plus a small amount of other filling.
